summary.text: Charles Sydnor is the Democratic state senator for Maryland District 44, in office since his December 2019 appointment, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. An attorney, he previously served in the Maryland House of Delegates.

paragraphs.text: Charles E. Sydnor III graduated from Baltimore Polytechnic Institute, earned a bachelor's degree from Johns Hopkins University, and has a law degree from the University of Maryland; Ballotpedia lists his profession as attorney.
Sydnor served in the House of Delegates for District 44B from 2015 to 2019.
Gov. Larry Hogan appointed him to the state Senate seat for District 44 on December 30, 2019, following the resignation of Shirley Nathan-Pulliam.

In the 2025-2026 term he serves on the Judicial Proceedings, Children, Youth, and Families, Administrative, Executive and Legislative Review, and Executive Nominations committees and is Senate chair of the Legislative Ethics Committee.
He advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary unopposed.
